Ivy (growth): FYI I dropped a slim pricing-page experiment: small FAQ tweak about commitments + a one-line micro-calculator. planning 24h canary at 5% then A/B for tier names. Need ops + tracking ready.
Ravi (product): paste the FAQ please? trying to keep it short.
Ivy (growth): "Committed capacity is billed monthly. Unused reserved units roll over as credits for the following month."
Sam (ops): ok. I'll add lead tag pricing_ex_v1 and webhook to SFDC. What fields to pass?
Ivy (growth): pass estimated_monthly, tier_variant, spike_multiplier, and pricing_ex_v1. If calc_submitted -> create lead.
Noah (analytics): I'll emit events: pricing_calc_start, pricing_calc_submit. Persist tier_variant=A|B|control. Will add dashboard tiles: calc completion and contact CTR.
Tasha (sales): good. If estimated_monthly > $6k route to AE_EMEA and ping channel.
marketing-bot: Reminder: pricing-ex-canary scheduled 2025-09-05T09:00Z.
Ivy (growth): timeline: copy + tracking today, ops to wire webhook EOD, deploy 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Keep variant names short for the test.
Ravi (product): prefer names: Launch / Growth / Enterprise. Keep voice friendly.
Sam (ops): will post webhook mapping in the PR.
Ivy (growth): thanks team — moving PR to review.
